description: This file contains utility functions for resolving writable rename targets, specifically for a sandbox environment in a file system bridge context. It provides functions to resolve targets, ensure writability, and create resolvers for renaming files or directories, with an emphasis on container paths.

methods.name: export function resolveWritableRenameTargets<T extends { containerPath: string }>(params: { resolveWritableRenameTargets
methods.description: Resolves 'from' and 'to' file targets for renaming, ensuring they are writable, based on provided resolve and ensure functions.

methods.name: export function resolveWritableRenameTargetsForBridge<T extends { containerPath: string }>( resolveWritableRenameTargetsForBridge
methods.description: A wrapper around resolveWritableRenameTargets, possibly for specific bridge scenarios.
